sentences.text: There are three ways to express a direction: true, magnetic and compass.
Variation is the difference between true and magnetic.
Deviation is the difference between magnetic and compass.
Remember the order with the phrase True Virgins Make Dull Companions: true, variation, magnetic, deviation, compass.
Going from compass toward true is called correcting, and you add easterly errors and subtract westerly ones.
Going from true toward compass is called uncorrecting, and you do the opposite: add westerly errors and subtract easterly ones.
Another memory aid for correcting is Can Dead Men Vote Twice At Elections: compass, deviation, magnetic, variation, true, add east.
